name: Para-iodoamphetamine
summary: para-Iodoamphetamine (PIA), also known as 4-iodoamphetamine (4-IA), is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA) and serotonergic neurotoxin of the amphetamine family related to para-chloroamphetamine (PCA).

pharmacology.text: PIA acts as a serotonin releasing agent (SRA). In animal drug discrimination tests, PIA fully substitutes for MDMA and (+)-MBDB. It also has very low affinity for certain serotonin receptors, including the serotonin 5-HT1 receptor (Ki = 7,660 nM) and the serotonin 5-HT2 receptor (Ki = 43,000 nM).
